renderings.kjv: over them as it were a sapphire

elsewhere.note: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.
Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.
His hands are like rings of gold set with beryl. His body is like ivory work overlaid with sapphires.
“You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your foundations with sapphires.
Her nobles were purer than snow. They were whiter than milk. They were more ruddy in body than rubies. Their polishing was like sapphire.
Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness…
